summary: Australia’s stock benchmark climbed to an intraday record on easing concerns over the US-Iran conflict and supportive signals in the domestic economy.

title: Gold Holds Steady as Progress on Hormuz Trims Rate-Hike Bets
summary: Gold traded in a narrow range, as the prospect of an interim deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz eased inflation concerns and reduced the odds of the US Federal Reserve raising interest rates.

title: SpaceX exceeds revenue estimates in first earnings report since IPO

title: Compass Shares Jump on Cost Savings, Transaction Growth
summary: Compass Inc. shares jumped as much as 15% in post-market trading after the real estate services firm said cost savings from the acquisition of competitor Anywhere were progressing ahead of schedule.

title: Booking Holdings Keeps Full-Year Outlook on Resilient Travel
summary: Booking Holdings Inc. maintained its full-year outlook for gross bookings and revenue due to resilient travel demand even as the Middle East conflict weighs on flight prices and capacity.

title: Whale Rock Sank 22% as AI Selloff Crippled Hedge Fund Returns
summary: Whale Rock Capital Management’s flagship hedge fund is one of the biggest losers in last month’s AI selloff, with a 21.7% drop in July erasing about half of its gains for the year.

title: Wynn’s New Middle Eastern Resort to Open in September 2027
summary: Wynn Resorts Ltd. said its first casino located in the Middle East will now open in September of next year.

title: Gold Gains With US-Iran Deal Hopes and Fed Outlook in Focus

title: Yen Rally Stalls Even as Bessent Vows Support After Intervention
summary: The yen’s rally stalled Tuesday even as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent pledged continued support for Japan following a historic joint intervention.

title: Apollo Invests $1 Billion in Joint Venture With Starwood REIT
summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is investing $1.02 billion in a joint venture with Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, a commercial property vehicle known as SREIT that has struggled to provide liquidity to investors.

title: Prudential Tops Estimates as Revenue From Asset Manager Soars
summary: Prudential Financial Inc. reported second-quarter results that beat Wall Street estimates as revenue from its asset manager surged.

title: Most Emerging-Market FX Gains as Oil Dips Below $80 Per Barrel
summary: Most emerging-market currencies gained on Tuesday, rebounding from an earlier selloff amid optimism the US and Iran are nearing a deal to restart peace talks.

title: US Revokes Brazilian Ambassador’s Visa Amid Diplomatic Spat
summary: The Trump administration revoked the visa for Brazil’s ambassador to the US after the country delayed giving diplomatic approval to Washington’s choice for envoy to Brasilia, a senior State Department official said Tuesday.

title: Codelco Halts Expansion Work at Top Mine on New Seismic Risk
summary: Codelco is suspending work on a project designed to extend the life of its biggest copper mine in Chile after identifying a new source of seismic risk a year after a rock burst killed six workers.

title: Treasury Options Splurge Risks Igniting Bigger Market Turbulence
summary: Bond traders have been spending millions of dollars to guard against sharp declines in long-dated Treasuries that risk igniting a bigger bout of volatility in the $31 trillion market.

title: S&P 500 Rises to All-Time High on Hormuz Deal Push: Markets Wrap
